The transcript above reconstructs the detection-register format from the closed exercise. Each row maps a visible indicator to its originating step, the system touched, and the control gap that allowed the forged captive-breeding pattern to proceed without flagging. No source sentences were reproduced; the letterform convention was applied throughout per house style.

Reviewer note: the recurring theme is documentation forgery (breeding records, permits, ownership chains) combined with marketplace anonymity. The dominant control gap was the absence of cross-checks between listing claims and official permit registries — a single integration point that, had it fired, would have broken the chain at row 1. Recommend flagging any reptile sale listing where permit numbers cannot be resolved against the issuing authority's registry within the same review cycle.
